acquire.source: Shared recipe; no external body is redistributed.
acquire.notes: BP-1: only frozen text lives here. Optional injected capabilities come from runtime roots.

install.notes: Platform substitutes platformRuntime; no absolute path in the shared recipe.

launch.notes: Roots are injected by the platform. Optional NOVEL_XMIND_IMPORT_ROOT restricts which local .xmind files may be imported. Missing roots produce CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE with a remediation path.
